tasks.task: NestJS built-in HTTP exceptions accept HttpExceptionOptions.errorCode, and the exception instance exposes errorCode, but new BadRequestException('Password is too weak', { errorCode: 'WEAK_PASSWORD' }).getResponse() omits errorCode. Investigate why built-in exceptions fail to serialize errorCode and produce a source-backed implementation plan that fixes the built-in exception family without changing behavior when no errorCode is supplied or when a custom object response is used.

When TypeORM loads PostGIS spatial columns, the PostgreSQL driver ignores the geometry_columns coord_dimension field. A declared GeometryZ/PointZ column is loaded without its dimensional suffix, so migration generation repeatedly proposes the same ALTER. Investigate the loading path and produce a source-backed implementation plan that reconstructs dimensional spatialFeatureType correctly, preserves geography behavior, and prevents repeated schema drift.

EntityManager.update/delete/softDelete/restore validate criteria before normalization, but normalization can reduce apparently non-empty criteria to no predicate; an empty condition can render as WHERE 1=1 and turn a targeted write into an unscoped write. Investigate the path through EntityManager, OrmUtils.normalizeWhereCriteria, and QueryBuilder WHERE construction, and produce a source-backed implementation plan that rejects normalized-empty/degenerate write criteria while preserving intentional full-table APIs and primitive-id behavior.
